author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
It’s a beautiful village baking day filled with the sweet aroma of strawberries 🍓🥧 In this video, we prepare a homemade strawberry pie alongside a rich, flavorful jam using fresh, ripe berries.

The pie comes out golden and flaky with a juicy, sweet filling, while the jam slowly thickens into a smooth, fragrant spread. Every step is simple, cozy, and full of that homemade charm.

This is traditional village baking at its sweetest — fresh ingredients, slow cooking, and recipes made with care. Perfect for enjoying a warm dessert and saving a taste of summer for later.
title: Village Baking Day – Sweet Strawberry Pie & Homemade Jam 🍓🥧
